scope: Post-fit analysis, reader tables and local export preparation from completed evidence. This is not experiment or public-release authority.

precedence.applies_to: Current 7350-observation common panel and integration of already selected simulator evidence.
precedence.replaces: Stale maintained instructions that the current common-panel runner is unimplemented, the neural run is pending, or the old export already contains the 7350 results. Frozen design-time status fields remain unchanged.
precedence.retrospective: Scores were already inspected. These additional analyses are exploratory; the 4515 sensitivity population was defined in the earlier common-panel contract. Do not call this new reporting lock prospective preregistration.

authorization.strong_pass: The user requested S1-S5 implementation after the progress audit.
authorization.execution_boundary: C1-C6 run on the subsequent routine-execution instruction. No additional scientific approval is needed between compliant reporting steps. License/citation/redistribution and actual publication remain owner decisions.

source_verification.rule: Verify these snapshot pins first, then follow every nested input/output pin and every graph/seed/transform identity consumed by the declared analysis. Development execution validation and public OOF replay are distinct scopes; omitted checkpoint/raw-source verification must be declared, never reported PASS. Same canonical ID is not enough. Do not repair a mismatch by replacing the expected hash.
source_verification.paths: All paths are development-root relative. selected_export is a read-only source during analysis; audit pinned source bytes before maintained export documents are updated.
source_verification.predictions: Join all 30 cell manifests and their output-hashed predictions/test_failures; five disjoint folds must cover the method/seed corpus with exactly one held-out outcome per ID within each seed.
source_verification.clarify_predictions: Five folds partition the 7350 IDs: each method/seed must cover 7350 IDs once, not predict every ID in all five folds.
source_verification.summary_authority: The existing complete summary is the metric baseline; it contains 31 method variants plus six seed diagnostics, not 37 different paper methods.

reference_sets.fit: For outer fold f, inner_fold in {1,2,3} within outer-train f. Reconstruct sorted identities from frozen CSVs and verify the saved transform/cell fit identity hashes.
reference_sets.validation: inner_fold=0 within outer-train f; no gradient fitting, but validation labels select the model epoch.
reference_sets.fit_plus_validation: Union of fit and validation; a separate selection-exposed diagnostic, never silently called gradient-training.
reference_sets.test: outer_fold=f. Never include its ID or labels in reference membership or refit transforms.

signatures.global_tensor: The actual float32 global vector after saved retained_indices, train-only mean/std and variable_mask; zeros for train-constant retained columns. No shots/backend/source/ID are appended.
signatures.graph_tensor: Actual float32 normalized x of shape (N,178), plus int64 edge_index of shape (2,E), exactly as the pinned _make_example encoder supplies. Retain node order, edge order, direction, duplicate edges and calibration-valued node fields.
signatures.graph_plus_global_tensor: Length-delimited concatenation of graph_tensor and global_tensor identities under the same fold transform.
signatures.encoding: SHA-256 over an explicit schema tag, array names, dtype, dimensions and little-endian C-order numeric payload. Canonicalize signed zero to positive zero; reject nonfinite values. No rounding, graph-isomorphism relabeling, runtime, model outputs, row IDs, filenames or ZIP metadata in the fingerprint.
signatures.scope: Equal signatures mean equal declared model input tensors, not exact original circuit identity, quantum equivalence or guaranteed equal runtime. Unseen signatures do not establish family/backend/topology OOD.
signatures.calculation: Use saved transforms unchanged, with independently checked NumPy reconstruction against pinned transform_global/_node_chunk conventions. Hash graph x in row chunks of at most 65536; cache by graph SHA plus fold-transform SHA. No CUDA/model forward call is needed.

S1_input_support.strata: For each of the three signature kinds, seen_in_fit/unseen_in_fit and seen_in_fit_plus_validation/unseen_in_fit_plus_validation, by source and pooled. Compare graph and matched MLP on exactly the same stratum IDs. Include polynomial as an additional comparator, not a matched-graph ablation.
S1_input_support.feature_masks: Report each fold's 51 raw global positions, retained flag, variable flag and saved transform hash; node mask is 178 positions. All five audited folds retain 40 global columns and 167 variable node columns. Retain the full 51-field raw schema; this is upstream train-only masking, not arbitrary feature selection.

qualified_input_sensitivity.rule: Exclude only candidate_recipe_sensitivity_only; reuse the same OOF predictions, not newly fitted models.

S2_analysis.joint_context: Also describe source_x_backend and source_x_shots counts; sparse context slices are descriptive, not new trained models or causal backend comparisons.
S2_analysis.dataset_profile: Use existing inputs to show observation/group counts, logical width/depth, target and shot distributions by source/tier; distinguish logical width from backend allocation. Report 206 full-panel groups: Ma-Li 148, Qonductor 52, QPack 6. Six QPack groups are transitive split components, not six independent execution rows or a claim that there are only six jobs.
S2_analysis.seed_reduction: Median of exactly seeds 42/1234/31415 per row for graph and MLP; retain all seed scores and per-row range/MAD summaries. No best-seed or best-fold selection.
S2_analysis.pair_scope: Compute all seven focused pairs on each declared population, using exact pair-successful IDs and independently scoring both methods on that intersection. Always show method population coverage and pair intersection coverage; never compare a subset MAE with the other method's full-panel MAE.

bootstrap.unit: Frozen common-panel group_id, restricted to the pair-successful population; draw that many groups with replacement and keep all their observations.
bootstrap.estimator: Pooled observation-weighted MAE difference and three-source-balanced MAE difference. Keep observed_delta, bootstrap_mean and percentile interval separate; a-minus-b sign is explicit.
bootstrap.empty_source: A source-balanced replicate lacking any of the three sources is invalid, not zero. Emit counts; use existing 9500-valid-replicate requirement for its interval.
bootstrap.small_support: Point metrics remain reported. Do not present a new inferential interval for a slice/pair with fewer than 20 distinct groups; mark insufficient_groups_for_interval. Twenty is a conservative internal display guard chosen for this exploratory report, not a theorem that bootstrap inference becomes valid at 20. No changing the threshold to obtain significance. Full-panel and 4515 focused pairs may use grouped intervals if support passes, with dependence and uncertainty limitations retained.
bootstrap.qualification: Intervals condition on these fitted OOF predictions, not fresh refits or new measurements. They are exploratory, pointwise and not multiplicity-adjusted; overlapping training folds and only six QPack components remain limitations.

S2_analysis.tails: List the top 20 absolute-error IDs per primary learned method per population, deterministic tie by canonical ID. Keep source/backend/shots/fold/tier/actual/prediction/group and seed spread. Mark post-fit diagnostic; no exclusion, winsorization or hypothesis of implementation failure from error size alone.
S2_analysis.hypothesis_boundary: This is descriptive input/error analysis, not a new feature ablation or causal proof. Runtime-depth correlations, if included, must be separately labeled descriptive Spearman association; no treating them as R2.
S2_analysis.undefined: R2 is undefined for fewer than two targets or zero target variance. Keep blank with an explicit reason. Preserve negative R2 and valid finite extreme predictions; never silently cap raw costs.

S3_reader_tables.real_qpu: One current method-family table on 7350 assigned rows: Ma-Li graph, matched MLP, Qonductor polynomial, QCRE, Qiskit reference, Hyb-HANAS, Scholten. Raw scheduled/cost values and fold-calibrated observed-service predictions are separate labeled variants. Show coverage beside every score and paired evidence beside any ranking claim.
S3_reader_tables.historical: 8767 compiled/mixed-stage results and source-native 340/4482 results remain a separate appendix; no transplanting their predictions or CI into the new panel.
S3_reader_tables.equivalence: QCRE and Qiskit matching schedule values under these inputs are two documented mechanisms/reference routes, not independent victories or independent experiment replications.
S3_reader_tables.simulator: One simulator method catalogue with engine/context-specific score blocks, not a shared wall-clock leaderboard across incompatible engines or tasks.

Ma-Li-style dense FP32 and FP64 graph/classical comparisons
recovered fixed-MPS runtime and quality-gated panel
Family-aware fixed-rung and joint runtime/quality adaptations with matched ablations

S3_reader_tables.catalogue_rule: Do not copy stale unavailable rows from an old compact table when a supported local adaptation now exists. Preserve separately unavailable original-paper routes, failed optimizer-on pilot, historical E6 target and missing exact wrapper with their exact scope.
S3_reader_tables.population: Digital predictor core has 162 members / 150 exact-QASM hashes at q2-q9. Full source panel has 204 members / 191 hashes through q16. Frontier attempts are coverage evidence, not extra successful predictor labels.
S3_reader_tables.quality: Show both all-finite and quality-qualified metrics where measured; quality filtering never removes failures from attempt denominator. Revisions and threshold remain explicit.
S3_reader_tables.fidelity: Use pinned method-card/source contract authority and completion/common-panel overrides. No changes to CURRENT or historical registries, no aliasing a local adaptation into an original-paper reproduction.

currently_supported: Graph has lower MAE than matched 51-raw-global MLP on this 7350 panel: the existing grouped interval excludes zero.
Graph-versus-polynomial MAE interval includes zero; neither a universal winner nor a robust superiority claim is established.
Polynomial has lower source-slice MAE than graph on Ma-Li and Qonductor; graph is lower on QPack. These are slices of the same unified fit.
Local Aer transpiled GNN improves over source GNN in the tested context, but does not clearly beat transpiled XGBoost on paired evidence.
Dense MAE and R2 select different favorable baselines; both metrics and tail errors are necessary.

Ridge intercept establishes isolated physical launch overhead

S4_claims.new_findings: C1-C3 may report computed support/tail/sensitivity findings under these boundaries. They may not edit the method, split or input population in response.

S5_delivery.baseline_boundary: The older clean-clone test does not cover the new common-panel payload. Keep its historical tested-commit evidence and add the newly tested snapshot to the same maintained reproduction_validation document.

reproduction_levels.metric_replay: Mandatory fresh-clone restore and numerical replay of old simulator and new common-panel results without original workspace fallbacks.
reproduction_levels.support_replay: Mandatory saved-feature/transform signature replay requires the consumed NPZ graph payloads; streaming/chunking and restoration must work without CUDA.
reproduction_levels.source_to_features: Document exact prerequisites and tested/not-tested status, including original archives and retrieval rights. Do not silently treat provided NPZ as independently reconstructed original data.
reproduction_levels.refit_or_remeasurement: Not authorized in this queue and not claimed verified by table replay. Training and GPU timing are hardware/environment-dependent.

S5_delivery.no_checkpoint_requirement: Model checkpoints are mathematically unnecessary for metric/support replay and excluded from that delivery by default. The existing aggregate_common_panel.load_mali does require every checkpoint in cell output_hashes: do not claim that unchanged loader works in a checkpoint-free clone. Keep checkpoints locally; preserve their historical hash entries and independent GPU replay receipt.
S5_delivery.portable_replay_adapter: Implement an explicitly labeled OOF-replay reader in the maintained analyzer/delivery layer. Verify final receipt and its 30 cell-manifest hashes, each consumed predictions/test_failures CSV hash, method/fold/seed/fit/validation/test identity, saved transforms, targets and partitions. Recompute seed medians and metrics from these CSVs. Do not deserialize a checkpoint, invent a new checkpoint-validation PASS or modify pinned development load_mali to bypass its gate. Record checkpoint_verification=not_in_replay_scope and distinguish the prior GPU replay receipt from fresh numerical replay. Apply the same consumed-input versus historical-prerequisite distinction to simulator evidence.
S5_delivery.excluded_scratch: Progress, caches, lease/PID files, polling logs, duplicate reports and temporary probes remain outside the delivery selection; no raw deletion. Any genuinely consumed dependency is retained or disclosed as an external prerequisite.
S5_delivery.minimal_tools: One new maintained analyzer, analyze_common_panel.py, with --build and --validate and one focused test module. Reuse existing aggregation/restore helpers. No separate one-off validator, dated receipt tree or experiment runner per task.

public_layout.operational_plans: Local only; exclude coordination documents, old task/wave checklists and agent-generated polling reports from the maintained public surface.

S5_delivery.path_mapping: Extend the existing release inventory with exact original_path/public_path/original_sha256/delivered_sha256/consumer/rights_status. Maintained public filenames must be semantic and version/date/task-free; frozen identifiers and original paths remain provenance metadata, not published filesystem layout. Preserve immutable evidence-member bytes; remapped containers and maintained references have separately computed hashes. Never claim the old hash covers rewritten bytes.
S5_delivery.relocation_boundary: Do not rename or edit frozen development files. Map only delivery paths; repair maintained imports/restore destinations and verify metrics. Do not regex-rename scientific IDs. Reject collisions, unresolved dependencies or missing rights rather than guessing.
S5_delivery.local_stage: Analysis and source inventory may proceed before owner rights choices. For a payload whose redistribution is pending, keep the staging local/internal and record its hold; no public push, license selection or silent claim of approval.
S5_delivery.status_repair: After checking all terminal cell manifests, final receipt and summary hashes, atomically repair only derived run_status.json to completed with links to the authority receipts. Preserve cell/progress history; do not change pinned trainer/helpers or historical contracts merely to fix display state.
clone_checks: restore all included CSV parts/evidence/feature graphs
install the declared CPU replay environment
independently recompute metrics and sample signature reconstruction
audit ID sets, failure and quality counts, links, dependency closure, file/archive naming, secret/cache exclusions
rebuild twice with unchanged inputs and require idempotence
verify no path falls back to development or publish_candidate and no GPU experiment is launched
check the clone remains clean apart from explicitly ignored derived work
S5_delivery.numeric_tolerance: Exact IDs/status/masks/signatures/hashes; metric arithmetic compared at rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10 (seconds for dimensional errors) to saved OOF recomputation. Bootstrap outputs require the declared RNG/draw rule and exact input identity; compare with the newly pinned deterministic builder, not a different resampling algorithm.
required_regression_checks: Different NPZ serialization/filenames with equal consumed tensors produce equal signatures; runtime/ID changes alone cannot change them.
A change removed by the saved variable mask does not change the consumed-tensor signature; a retained variable feature change does.
Reversing an asymmetric edge or changing edge multiplicity changes graph signatures; graph-only equality with different globals is not combined-input equality.
A signature appearing only in validation is unseen_in_fit but seen_in_fit_plus_validation; test IDs cannot be reference matches.
Chunked and unchunked hashing agree; signed zero canonicalization is deterministic; nonfinite tensors fail.
Per-seed coverage is one OOF outcome per ID, three fixed seeds produce a median, and a missing seed cannot be silently reduced to two.
Pairwise scores are recomputed on shared successful IDs, and filtering candidate tier yields exactly 4515 assigned rows without refitting.
Group-bootstrap draws retain whole unequal-sized groups; source-balanced empty-source replicates and fewer-than-20-group intervals are explicit.
Tampered consumed CSV/transform/cell/receipt pins fail; a declared checkpoint-free OOF replay neither loads checkpoints nor reports them newly verified.
Portable replay has no development-workspace fallback or GPU forward/training call and is idempotent on unchanged restored inputs.
S5_delivery.completion: S1-S5 lock is complete; C1-C6 implementation, new clone verification and owner publication gates are not complete until their actual evidence exists.

scheduling.resources: CPU-only; at most four auxiliary numerical threads in total, 8 GiB RSS per worker and 24 GiB aggregate, minimum 8 GiB RAM available. One file owner at a time.
scheduling.parallel: C1 signature implementation/read-only hash work and C2 metric implementation may run concurrently with disjoint functions/modules coordinated by one owner of analyze_common_panel.py. Prefer coordinator merges rather than simultaneous script writes. C4 drafts may start from locked wording. C3 follows C1/C2 numerical artifacts; C5 final integration follows C3/C4; C6 runs on a stable payload with no concurrent writes.
scheduling.manifest_owner: The coordinator alone writes the analysis manifest, reader selection, export mapping/inventory and final validation record.
scheduling.checkpoints: Validate a small real subset across all three sources and two folds plus synthetic collision/mask fixtures before full 7350 support generation. This is a reporting check, not new simulator timing.

review_reference_snapshot.meaning: Reviewed baseline text, not analyzer runtime input. Maintained documents may be edited during C4-C5; their old bytes remain recoverable from this Git snapshot. Do not require mutable prose to retain an old hash after an authorized update.
